encodingDesc.p: Surfaces identify printed metrical appendix pages. This file is a facsimile inventory, not a translation edition or a CTS line alignment. No metrical quantities have been reconstructed from OCR. Continued schemes remain intact across successive page images. Verse links require independent verification against Donner’s native numbering and the Smyth reference.
